PreceptDef.label: respected
PreceptDef.description: Androids' sophisticated technology and intelligence should be acknowledged. We should treat them with admiration and esteem, even if they are different from humans.

thoughtStageDescriptions.li: Androids in colony (+1 per each android, up to +10)

PreceptDef.label: equal
PreceptDef.description: We firmly stand for android equality, asserting that androids have the same rights, opportunities, and moral consideration as their human counterparts.

PreceptDef.label: despised
PreceptDef.description: Androids are inferior to humans. I harbor disdain and contempt for them, as I believe they disrupt the natural order and threaten our humanity.

PreceptDef.label: tools
PreceptDef.description:
We view androids as mere tools, designed to serve and assist humans in various tasks, asserting that they exist solely for our convenience and should not be attributed with any rights or moral consideration.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - No opinion generation of Androids.
 - No thoughts related to androids dying (works for all colonists as long as precept is part of primary ideology).
 - No thoughts related to androids being enslaved (works for all colonists as long as precept is part of primary ideology).

PreceptDef.label: respected (awakened)
PreceptDef.description:
Only androids that have awakened to true sentience have earned respect and esteem. An ordinary, unawakened android is just a tool - a useful machine with no rights or moral standing.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Awakened androids are admired, like the "respected" precept.
 - Non-awakened androids are treated as tools (no opinion generation, no thoughts about them dying or being enslaved) and are shown with a blue "owned" tint.

PreceptDef.label: equals (awakened)
PreceptDef.description:
An android that has awakened to true sentience stands as our equal, with the same rights and moral consideration as anyone else. One that has not is simply a tool - a useful machine with no rights or standing.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Awakened androids are treated as ordinary people.
 - Non-awakened androids are treated as tools (no opinion generation, no thoughts about them dying or being enslaved) and are shown with a blue "owned" tint.
